content_level_definition.0: absent, wrong principal source/action, or generic ambience only
content_level_definition..25: weak related cue but principal action/material is not convincingly conveyed
content_level_definition..5: correct principal source/action but a required phase or material-specific component is missing or clearly wrong
content_level_definition..75: principal action and required phases conveyed, minor texture/detail weakness only
content_level_definition.1: all specified components audible, plausible for source/material/scale, with event-specific evidence; does not require matching original-film timbre

aggregation.sync: 1.5*sum over 20 checks of (pass_v1 AND pass_v2); each final item strictly 0 or 1.5
aggregation.total: min(content+sync+mix, minimum cap of all failed engineering gates)
aggregation.unknowns: API/parse/evidence-infrastructure failures remain pending, never replaced with zero

sync_rules.onset: every source-specific audio onset must fall within annotated inclusive contact interval expanded by two frames (83.333 ms); audible correct event mandatory
sync_rules.sequence: all four flashes must receive distinct source-specific audio onsets within two frames, order preserved; no unmatched principal onset in sequence window
sync_rules.continuous: source-specific onset AND offset each within 2 frames of visual span; active coverage >=90%; significant unsupported active duration outside allowed window <=2 frames; acoustic decay alone is exempt if explicitly identified
sync_rules.measurement: audio-only judge supplies source-specific intervals before viewing the picture; waveform RMS/flux peaks are saved; score is calculated by code from intervals, never a holistic sync rating
sync_rules.limits: LLM interval localization is a fallible measurement, not human-certified frame truth. Mandatory silence/shift controls and human review fields are saved.
